hooks.command: bash -c 'cmd=$(cat /dev/stdin | jq -r ".tool_input.command // empty"); if echo "$cmd" | grep -qiE "rm -rf|drop database|format c|shutdown|del /s /q|rmdir /s"; then echo "BLOCKED: Destructive command detected — $cmd" >&2; exit 2; fi'

bash -c 'fp=$(cat /dev/stdin | jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty"); if echo "$fp" | grep -qE "\.(env|env\.local|env\.production|env\.staging)$"; then echo "BLOCKED: Cannot modify env files directly. Use .env.example instead." >&2; exit 2; fi'

bash -c 'input=$(cat /dev/stdin); fp=$(echo "$input" | jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty"); content=$(echo "$input" | jq -r ".tool_input.content // empty"); if echo "$fp" | grep -q "client/src" && echo "$content" | grep -qE "sk-[a-zA-Z0-9]{20,}|AIza[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{30,}|OPENAI_API_KEY"; then echo "BLOCKED: API keys must NOT be in client-side code. Use environment variables on the server." >&2; exit 2; fi'
bash -c 'fp=$(cat /dev/stdin | jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty"); ext="${fp##*.}"; if [[ "$ext" =~ ^(js|jsx|ts|tsx|css|json|md)$ ]]; then npx prettier --write "$fp" 2>/dev/null || true; fi'
bash -c 'fp=$(cat /dev/stdin | jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty"); ext="${fp##*.}"; if [[ "$ext" =~ ^(js|jsx)$ ]]; then npx eslint --fix --quiet "$fp" 2>/dev/null || true; fi'

bash -c 'fp=$(cat /dev/stdin | jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty"); if echo "$fp" | grep -qE "server/src/models/.*\.js$"; then cd server && npx vitest run tests/unit/models/ --reporter=verbose 2>&1 | tail -5 || true; fi'

powershell -NoProfile -Command "Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Windows.Forms; [System.Windows.Forms.MessageBox]::Show('Claude Code needs your attention — CodeNexus Dev', 'CodeNexus', 'OK', 'Information') | Out-Null"
